Separately, D12 (broker-terminal => adjust same pass) and D23 (broker-live => defer) could not diverge because the probe result never fed the in-flight computation.

findings.lens: safety+correctness (merges 2 raw: 'cash drift self-absolves'; 'unconditional baseline refresh absorbs unadjudicated cash / anchors torn pairs')
findings.title: Unconditional every-pass baseline refresh let unexplained cash drift self-absolve in one pass interval, and anchored torn (cash, watermark) pairs when the lens was skipped
findings.problem: FD-M6-17 refreshed the cash baseline at the end of EVERY completed pass — including the pass that found an unexplained residue (the next pass starts at the drifted value, comes back clean, FD-M6-6 auto-clears: money appearing/vanishing self-absolves with no human in the loop, contradicting A1, the latched_operator vocabulary, and §1 row 3) — and including passes where the lens was skipped in-flight (the torn read becomes the next telescope's baseline paired with a watermark that cannot cover broker-executed-but-unbooked fills: false drift one way, silent absorption the other).

resolution.detail: FD-M6-17 rewritten: the (cash_usd, fills_seq_watermark) pair refreshes ONLY when the cash lens evaluated this pass AND found zero residue (or first-ever seed, itself requiring an empty deferral set); skipped or residue-bearing passes carry the previous pair forward byte-identical, so the residue re-detects every pass and the latch genuinely holds for the operator. New operator path: agent reconcile --rebaseline-cash (§E) is the ONLY producer of action 'rebaselined'. A1/A6/§1 row 19/D6/D32 updated; tests 4.33/4.34, 5.16/5.17 added.

findings.title: flatten-never-flip and position-existence were pinned only in the PURE planner — record_position_adjust and the PaperBook fold had no adjusted_qty >= 0 or unknown-position_id pins, so a bad adjust row folds a flipped/manufactured position silently

A negative-qty adjust row (future planner bug, facade caller bug, or V26-pattern seeded fixture) passes the prev check and folds a SHORT position with status 'open' on every restart — in direct contrast to the adjacent close-fold precedent which raises on new_qty < 0 and unknown position_id (verified paper_book.py:663-674); create-on-miss could manufacture a position the broker never reported.

Tests 3.1 extended + 3.11-3.13 added (seeded negative row => rehydrate raises; unknown id => raises; adjust-of-closed => raises).

findings.title: LIFO cost re-anchoring rode the LAST planned adjust, which can be a position flattened to qty 0 (closed) — the open-sum constraint becomes unsatisfiable and the FD-M6-2 fixpoint breaks
findings.problem: When the negative-delta cascade exhausts exactly at a position boundary, the last planned adjust closes that position, excluding it from the open sum its adjusted_broker_cost_usd was supposed to satisfy; untouched older lots keep drifted cost, the next pass re-detects position_avg_cost, and 'running a pass twice is structurally idempotent' / D20's empty second pass are violated — the latch can never clear autonomously on machine-explainable drift. The position choice for the sole cost-only adjust was also unspecified, breaking adjust_id determinism.

resolution.detail: §A.1 re-anchors on the NEWEST position remaining OPEN post-plan; when no touched position stays open but untouched open lots remain, one additional cost-only adjust on the newest open lot; the sole cost-only adjust (qty agreeing) pinned to the newest open position. Boundary-exhaustion test 1.24 added (fixpoint preserved).

findings.title: Pass-end detector seeding contradicted the 'reconciled point' requirement: frozen, deferred, broker-only and immediate-phase symbols were seeded at unreconciled points
findings.problem: The seeding loop ran at the end of EVERY completed pass for EVERY held mapped symbol with no exclusions — for a CA-frozen durable the seed overwrites the baseline with the post-CA drifted qty (precisely the absorption S7-2 forbids; seed_baseline has no frozen guard — verified corporate_actions.py:515-519), and immediate passes (which adjust nothing) re-seeded the frozen symbol in the same tick. The pinned S7 test 'baselines seeded only at reconciled points' could not pass against the pseudocode.
findings.evidence: rev1 :197, :687-692, :191, :982; repo scripts/agent/corporate_actions.py:505-519 (verified: no frozen guard, _frozen never cleared by seed).

resolution.detail: FD-M6-14 + §D step 7 restrict seeding to {sod,eod,cli} completed passes and to symbols where post-pass local folded qty == broker qty; frozen, deferral-set and broker-only symbols skipped; immediate passes seed nothing; a frozen durable is never re-seeded until the M7 operator unfreeze. findings.title: occurrence/pass_count counting rule contradicted itself in three places; repeated incomplete immediate passes minted colliding reconcile_id/drift_id, breaking S6

Two same-run incomplete immediate passes shared one occurrence => identical reconcile_id and drift_id across distinct passes — uncorrelatable rows (S6).

findings.title: Contract both forbade and required a schedule consult for _session_over; the same-session-post-close D14 case was undecidable without schedule_for, and UnknownSessionDate was an unenumerated mid-pass crash

findings.problem: §0.1 asserted the reconcile path never calls schedule_for/phase_at while §D's _session_over compared 'the recorded instant against the fixture schedule' — which IS a schedule_for consult; a pure date compare silently degrades D14 (nightly cron runs on the SAME session date as the DAY order), while consulting the schedule can raise UnknownSessionDate (verified market_calendar.py:56, :275-279), a failure mode FD-M6-7 did not enumerate.

findings.title: Flatten-probe PROBE_FAILED never reaches the deferral set: a kill-residual symbol with a failed flatten probe was adjustable over a possibly-live flatten (M6C-3-introduced gap + §3 internal contradiction)
findings.problem: §3's generic failure row ('any | probe raised ... | symbol stays in the deferral set') is only satisfiable structurally for journaled orders (they remain in open_orders, picked up at step 4b). For flatten probes, the dedicated failed row OMITTED the deferral clause, and the pseudocode's PROBE_FAILED branch ('notes.append(...); completed = False; continue') bypasses resolve_order_probe entirely, so ProbeResolution.defer_symbols is unreachable; step 4b's deferral sources (open_orders ∪ _open_deny ∪ task) never contain kill-residual symbols. Result: when a flatten probe FAILS (BrokerTimeout / non-404 error-as-data) on a drifted residual symbol (e.g. a partially-filled flatten), the position lens plans and writes a position_adjust over a possibly-still-live flatten order in the same pass — exactly the hazard the adjacent live-flatten row exists to prevent. A failed probe is strictly LESS information than a live result, so fail-closed demands at least the same deferral. The contradiction between the generic 'any' row and the flatten-failed row also made the build ambiguous.

findings.problem: FD-M6-11/§E define exit 1 as 'drift found this pass OR a pre-existing latch still set' and exit 3 as 'could not reconcile / not completed', with no precedence rule. The D35 row (RC-9) is the first composition where DRIFT IS FOUND AND JOURNALED THIS PASS (the position_qty adjust_deferred finding) while the pass is simultaneously completed=false (failed flatten probe) — both clauses match literally, and D35 pins exit 3. D22 already pinned 3 over the 'pre-existing latch still set' arm, but D35 newly extends the collision to the 'drift found this pass' arm, so two faithful builders could pin different exits (1 vs 3) for the same frozen matrix row and byte-pin different file-5 goldens. Not fail-open (both exits are non-zero and the runbook alerts on ANY non-zero per M6C-25; the latch is set and re-surfaces as exit 1 on the next completed pass), but the frozen exit table should be deterministic without consulting matrix rows.
